nodes.label: Wedding Event Image
nodes.description: Polaroid-style photo of a joyful bride and groom embracing at an outdoor garden wedding at sunset, with guests in the background and string lights. Caption reads 'Our Joy - Oct 12, 2023'.

nodes.label: Birthday Event Image
nodes.description: Polaroid-style photo of a woman wearing a 'Sarah 28' paper crown blowing out candles on a 'Happy Birthday' cake, surrounded by cheering friends in a cozy room with bunting and string lights.

nodes.label: Concert Event Image
nodes.description: Polaroid-style photo of a live concert stage with colorful lighting and a crowd with raised hands. Caption reads 'Oct '91 Live!'.

nodes.label: Graduation Event Image
nodes.description: Polaroid-style photo of a graduate in cap and gown tossing her cap into the air, holding a diploma, with a campus clock tower (resembling UC Berkeley's Campanile) and other graduates in the background at sunset.

nodes.label: Reunion Event Image
nodes.description: Polaroid-style photo of a multi-generational family gathered at an outdoor picnic, laughing together with drinks and food. Caption reads 'July 4th, 1982'.

nodes.label: Default Event Image
nodes.description: Flat illustration of four diverse stylized people in colorful casual clothing on a pink background, used as the generic fallback image for events without a category-specific image.

Polaroid-style photo of a multi-generational family laughing at an outdoor July 4th 1982 picnic, captioned 'July 4th, 1982'. Likely used for the team/about section to evoke nostalgia and shared memories.
Indian wedding ceremony with bride and groom at a floral mandap while guests photograph them; phone overlay shows a 'Live Wedding Gallery' app screen. Promotes live event galleries.
Split comparison: 'Google Drive: Cluttered & Slow' showing a frustrated groom with messy file folders versus 'Modern Event App: Live & Elegant' showing a phone with Photo Gallery and Guest Photos.
Conceptual illustration: 'Trapped Memories' as locked cloud folders with QR codes versus 'Shared Collaboration' on a tablet displaying wedding photos in a connected gallery.

Editorial banner 'The Art of Seeing: A Photographic Evolution' showing progression from antique bellows camera to Leica rangefinder to Olympus point-and-shoot to a modern smartphone capturing landscape.
